attempt_2.test_verdict: none: RBE execution failed before a TestResult

attempt_2.root_cause_limits: The first physical attempt cold-booted and did not create the failing snapshot. The failed snapshot creator/CPU/TSC values are not exposed; C3-to-C2 across these attempts does not prove cross-model reuse caused the restore failure.

rejected_policy_candidate.proposal: allow-remote-snapshots=false plus snapshot-read-policy=local-only for VM test
rejected_policy_candidate.reason: BuildBuddy shouldSaveLocalSnapshot returns false for a restored local snapshot when remote snapshots are disabled, before the save policy is considered; changed k3s fingerprints would not refresh the local snapshot.

attempt_3.verdict: one fresh remote FAILED VM test, 451.645 s
attempt_3.first_failure: VM1 guest supervision fixture subtest reap_retries_property_deadline_on_connected_manager failed at final assertSystemdProofEmpty / ReadSystemdUnit with context deadline exceeded; native unit had exited status 23.
attempt_3.rerun: same fixture reran later in the test and passed, but check_boot retained the earlier failure marker and correctly rejected boot evidence
attempt_3.context_limit: The 10 s readCtx spans prior retries, WriteLine, Wait, stream joins and final proof read. Retained logs do not timestamp Wait completion or final read entry; it is unknown whether context was already ended before that read or the D-Bus call consumed the remaining budget.

pr_15493.fixture_timeout_change: PR head changed central_sampler turn_timeout_seconds 60 to 240 only inside if central_sampler; local-model-vm renders central_sampler=false. The VM driver's independent TURN_SECONDS remains 300; this PR setting did not cause or prolong these VM waits.

attempt_4.verdict: one fresh remote FAILED VM test, 739.222 s; pytest-timeout >600 s
attempt_4.first_failure: JUnit test start 23:00:52.406424 UTC; pytest 600 s deadline about 23:10:52.406. Test failed with Timeout (>600.0s) from pytest-timeout, not a scenario assertion.
attempt_4.setup: system_test.stack.setup 23:00:54.227–23:06:17.756 =323.5 s; k3s bootstrap 36.8 s; serial image imports include KubeVirt virt-launcher 46.6 s and VM guest root 49.1 s.
attempt_4.scenario: system_test.case 23:06:21.257–23:11:25.398 =304.1 s; three concurrent scenarios. At pytest deadline VM1 final turn.wait was active (23:10:45.205–23:10:52.975), VM2 and OOM sandbox delete had been accepted (23:10:18.130 and 23:10:36.847) but lacked deleted events. VM1 sandbox cleanup started 23:10:53.166 and recorded deleted 23:11:25.389.
attempt_4.mechanism_limit: The aggregate 600 s budget was exhausted with active setup and scenarios. VM2/OOM cleanup spans ended around the pytest deadline without deleted events; teardown Kubernetes events show their VM shutdown/deletion continuing. These data do not prove a deletion wedge or explain why setup/import took these durations. No timeout increase is justified by matched timing evidence yet.
attempt_4.action_digest_note: Different test-action digest from attempts 1–3 despite the same tested synthetic merge SHA; do not treat it as a same-action execution.

setup_phase_counts.interpretation: Import spans are serial with one importer, but overlap other stack setup; their sum is not an additional critical-path duration. Pruning is too small to explain the 600 s deadline.

source_assessment.finding: Existing importer overlaps one serial, blob-deduplicated stream with other setup. A historical concurrent-import trial was slower on a generally slower worker and cannot establish a speedup; controlled image-store pressure evidence supports retaining pruning. No source regression or safe optimization sufficient to avert this attempt is established.

attempt_5.interpretation: The fifth job passed, but its VM result was cached. Matching artifacts identify a separate fresh warm pass; they do not make attempt 5 a fresh execution or prove that the earlier failure paths were fixed.

limits: This is a focused VM and #15493 snapshot, not a repository-wide failure-rate census. No complete GitHub PR job or merged-PR population was collected for this new window.
GetTargetStats 98 and target-history 917 use different API definitions; neither is a verified count of fresh physical executions. Complete cache status was not retrieved.

The target history lacks a per-row branch field; selected invocation metadata confirms devel, and the #15493 PR child IDs are absent. The report does not claim every indexed row is independently branch-verified.

The first four #15493 jobs failed before the 10 November 23:13 UTC cutoff; they are a selected PR run, not a full PR-attempt census. Three fresh failed VM TestResults and one RBE pre-verdict failure must remain separate. Attempt 4 used a different test-action digest.

The devel-filtered stats and branch-unverified target history sample ended at 23:04 UTC; selected PR observations ended at 23:13 UTC. The separate populations and cutoffs are not combined into one rate.
No guest kernel trace after the VM2 console cutoff, snapshot creator metadata, or timestamp at entry to the final systemd proof read was retained.
Full API payloads, logs and profiles remain in local scratch; only reviewed measurements and identifiers are published.
